function: Joint passive sensing (range, velocity of targets) and communication symbol detection in an OFDM MIMO receiver, via an unfolded D-AMP/2D-DFT/channel-reconstruction network (pp. 16-19).
system: OFDM MIMO with 8 transmit and 8 receive antennas, 16-QAM, 4 GHz carrier, 123 MHz bandwidth, 1024 subcarriers, 1-3 targets, passive sensing; no RIS (p. 21).
method: Deep-unfolding network, K layers with five learnable parameters each (eta1-eta5), trained offline on simulated data (95% train), 500 epochs, batch 128, rate 0.001 (pp. 19-20).
data_channel: Own MATLAB-simulated multipath OFDM ISAC channel with Weibull small-scale fading, radar-equation large-scale fading; SNR -20 to 60 dB; 95% training, 5% test (pp. 9, 20).
test_conditions: Training and testing on the same simulated setup (95%/5% split); parameters trained per SNR; single-target and three-target scenarios tested, SNR -20 to 60 dB (pp. 20, 25).
baselines: Non-learned: MAP detector with CSI error, 2D-DFT sensing [11], Algorithm 3 (same iterations without learnable parameters), perfect-information reference; learned: OAMP-Net2 [21] (p. 25).
metrics: BER, SER, NMSE of range and velocity, convergence versus number of layers (pp. 22-25).
complexity: Five learnable variables per layer, described as much fewer than data-driven DL; no operation count or runtime (pp. 19-20).
q1_support: p. 9: "obeys the Weibull distribution [26]" - custom MATLAB-simulated multipath ISAC channel (page 20); 3GPP TS 38.913 [25] is cited only for simulation parameters, not as a channel model.
q2_support: p. 20: "is used for training and 5% data is used for testing" - held-out part of the same simulated data with parameters trained per SNR; no scenario, configuration or dataset unseen in training is reported.
q3_support: p. 25: "compares the BER and SER of MAP [21], OAMP-Net2 [21], Algorithm 3" - MAP and 2D-DFT [11] are non-learned, OAMP-Net2 [21] is an earlier learned detector; sensing NMSE is compared with 2D-DFT.
q4_support: p. 19: "there are five main learnable variables" - five learnable parameters per layer, stated as a design remark (continues on page 20); no complexity order, operation count or runtime is given.
q5_support: p. 20: "obtained training and testing data sets through MATLAB simulation" - simulated data; no link or release statement for code or data anywhere in the paper.
notes: Deep-unfolded receiver that jointly detects data symbols and estimates target range and velocity (passive sensing). Area 5 because the learned processing serves sensing and communication together; area 1 would apply if the reviewer reads only the detection module (BER and SER against OAMP-Net2). q4 is borderline: the only cost statement is five learnable variables per layer, with no complexity order, FLOPs or runtime, so the reviewer may want to confirm it. The PDF is an arXiv draft dated July 31, 2023.
